name: MAGIC of LUST
detailed_description:
Magic of Lust is a visual novel for adults only. Secrets from the past, the awakening of an ancient power, and dangerous feelings lead Diana down a path where magic and passion intertwine, blurring the lines between desire and destiny.

After moving to a new city and starting a dream job, young artist Diana faces the fact that her life is not what she thought it was. Finding herself the last heiress of an ancient clan of witches, she is drawn into a dangerous maelstrom of magic, betrayal, and seduction. Her friend Sophie turns out to be a guardian, and the mysterious brothers sent to protect her awaken feelings she doesn't know how to handle.

But as the gift awakens in the girl's chest, her enemies are close at hand. And even the most innocent looking person can turn out to be a monster in human form. Violence, kidnapping, struggle for survival and awakened magic - all this is just the beginning of the path on which Diana will have to make a choice: to submit to fate or rewrite it.

Magic of Lust is a story about how sexuality, fear and power can intertwine into one. It's about how opening yourself up to passion can lead to freedom. But also lose yourself.

Features of the game:

A gripping story and emotional journey of the main character: Diana's story is full of intense moments and emotional experiences that are captivating from the beginning and hold on to the end.

Unique characters with elaborate personalities: Each character has their own personality and motivations, adding depth and realism to the game.

Colorful visual style and pleasant soundtrack: The game delights with vivid graphics and atmospheric music, creating an unforgettable immersion.

Intimate and inspiring atmosphere: The game combines suspense and moments of personal revelation to create a unique atmosphere that inspires and captivates.
